seoDescription: Whole-home Mesh Wi-Fi design, installation and setup for Ivanhoe and Eaglemont homes, with transparent pricing and hardware sold at cost.
headline: Wi-Fi that reaches the rooms where you actually use it.
promise: We diagnose the weak spots, design the right Mesh Wi-Fi layout, install the hardware and leave you with a network you understand.
investmentNote: Typical GST-inclusive total including hardware and installation. Final scope depends on your property and coverage needs.

problems.title: Rooms drop out
problems.body: The connection is fine beside the router, then disappears where work, streaming or smart devices happen.

problems.title: Extenders disappoint
problems.body: A patchwork of boosters creates extra network names, unreliable hand-offs and more things to reset.

problems.title: Nobody can explain it
problems.body: You have equipment, apps and flashing lights, but no clear picture of what is connected or why it is slow.

inclusions: On-site review of your layout and current network
Mesh Wi-Fi hardware installation and configuration
Network naming, security and device connection setup
Practical handover so you know how the system works
Tidy-up of redundant networking equipment where appropriate

process.title: Show us the weak spots
process.body: Tell us where the signal drops, what you use there and which devices matter most.

process.title: We map and install
process.body: We assess the property, recommend an appropriate layout and configure the Mesh system.

process.title: Walk away connected
process.body: We connect priority devices, explain the setup and leave the network ready for everyday use.

assurances.title: No hardware markup
assurances.body: Recommended hardware is sold at cost, so the advice is not shaped by a sales margin.

assurances.title: Local call-out included
assurances.body: There is no call-out fee for appointments in Ivanhoe or Eaglemont.

assurances.title: Plain-English handover
assurances.body: You get a clear explanation of what was installed and how to use it.

faqs.question: Do I need to buy the Mesh hardware first?
faqs.answer: No. We can assess the layout and recommend suitable hardware. If you already own equipment, we can review whether it fits the job.

faqs.question: Will Mesh Wi-Fi make my internet plan faster?
faqs.answer: Mesh Wi-Fi improves coverage and the connection inside your home; it cannot increase the speed supplied by your internet plan. We will separate those two issues during diagnosis.

faqs.question: Why is the investment shown as a range?
faqs.answer: Homes differ in size, construction and coverage needs. The range reflects the usual combination of hardware and installation, with the final scope agreed for your property.

seoDescription: A cleaner, better-connected Ivanhoe and Eaglemont home office with monitor mounting, cable management and video-call lighting as a $350 fixed-price project including GST.
headline: A home office that looks composed and works that way too.
promise: We straighten the cables, position the screens and improve the video-call setup so your workspace supports the work instead of interrupting it.
investmentNote: GST-inclusive fixed project price for the standard home-office reset. Any required hardware is additional and discussed with you.

problems.title: The desk fights back
problems.body: Cables snag, chargers migrate and every change turns into another improvised adapter.

problems.title: Calls look and sound rough
problems.body: The screen, camera and light are in the wrong places, making every meeting harder than it needs to be.

problems.title: The setup never feels finished
problems.body: The equipment works individually, but the whole workspace still looks temporary and behaves unpredictably.

inclusions: Cable routing and practical desk organisation
Monitor arm or mount setup where suitable
Dock, charger and peripheral connection tidy-up
Camera position and video-call lighting setup
Final test of the everyday work setup

process.title: Show us how you work
process.body: We identify the devices, calls and daily movements your setup needs to support.

process.title: Reset the workspace
process.body: We route, mount, connect and position the equipment around that workflow.

process.title: Test the pose
process.body: We check screens, peripherals and a real camera view before calling the setup complete.

assurances.title: A defined project price
assurances.body: The standard home-office reset is a $350 fixed-price project.

assurances.title: Function before decoration
assurances.body: The setup is organised around how you work, not just how the desk looks in a photo.

assurances.title: One joined-up check
assurances.body: We test the equipment as a working desk setup rather than treating each item in isolation.

faqs.question: Does the $350 include monitor arms or other hardware?
faqs.answer: The fixed project price covers the standard home-office reset. Any hardware needed for your chosen setup is discussed separately before installation.

faqs.question: Can you help me choose what to buy?
faqs.answer: Yes. If the current equipment does not support the layout you want, we can help identify the practical gaps before you spend.

faqs.question: What should I have ready for the visit?
faqs.answer: Have the devices, chargers and accessories you regularly use available, plus access to the desk and nearby power points.
